# Goodreads Scraper

> An Apify actor that looks up books by title or author and returns the average rating, number of ratings, page count, cover image and description, one row per book, without a login.

## Docs

- [Apify Store page](https://apify.com/goat255/goodreads-scraper): run it, prices, input form
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): input and output fields, MCP and HTTP setup for AI agents
- [README.md](README.md): overview, use cases and a demo video

## Quick call

- POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/goat255~goodreads-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN with body {"titles": ["an example novel"], "maxMatchesPerTitle": 1}

## More

- [All our actors](https://apify.com/goat255)
